Welcome to my channel 👋 

Hi! I'm a newly graduated veterinary surgeon based in London, UK. On this channel, I share pet health tips, wellness advice, and lifestyle content to help you and your furry friends live your best lives together. Whether you're a pet parent or just love animals, there's something here for you. 🐶🐱✨

Don’t forget to subscribe for weekly videos and join our growing community of pet lovers! 💛
